import { __faberDisplay } from "@faber/runtime";

declare global {
    interface Number {
        potentia(exponent: number): number;
    }
}
Number.prototype.potentia = function(this: Number, exponent: number): number {
    return Math.pow(this.valueOf(), exponent);
};

class Span {
    low!: number;
    high!: number;
    toString(): string {
        return "Span { low = " + __faberDisplay(this.low, "fractus") + ", high = " + __faberDisplay(this.high, "fractus") + " }";
    }
    contains(x: number): boolean {
        return ((this.low <= x) && (x <= this.high));
    }
    center(): number {
        return ((this.low + this.high) / 2);
    }
}
